G001.target_statement: Search a city subreddit with a keyword to learn about a specific local topic.
G001.label: direct
G001.rationale: 原句明确说出想看万圣节相关信息时，用关键词在城市 subreddit 内搜索获取信息；主体、对象（话题信息）与方式（关键词、特定 subreddit）一致。

G002.target_statement: Scroll the newsfeed of followed subreddits during idle downtime until an interesting post appears, then open and interact with it.
G002.label: direct
G002.rationale: T007 描述滚动信息流直到发现感兴趣内容并打开互动；T025 说明多发生在午餐、公交等空闲时段；T003 以 'kill some time' 说明动机。三处合为同一浏览目标，条件为无预设查找目标。

G003.target_statement: Use technical-help subreddits as an alternative to Stack Overflow when stuck on a problem or needing other input.
G003.label: direct
G003.rationale: 原句把 Reddit 技术求助 subreddit 明确定位为 Stack Overflow 的替代，并给出触发条件（卡住、需要额外输入）。

G004.target_statement: Get results targeted to the specific problem being faced rather than generalized search results.
G004.label: direct
G004.rationale: 受访者用一句话概括使用 Reddit 的主要理由，就是得到针对所面对问题的结果，与 Google 的泛化结果相对。

G005.target_statement: Get personal, contextual experiences from other people rather than general facts when evaluating something.
G005.label: direct
G005.rationale: 原句明确给出偏好方向：个人经验优先于事实性资料，理由是其情境性且更有价值；属于信息质量目标，不是单纯口味。

G006.target_statement: Reach the relevant post directly through a Google search with Reddit appended, instead of searching inside Reddit, when a problem is targeted.
G006.label: direct
G006.rationale: T007 明确描述有具体问题时的入口方式（Google 提问加 Reddit 后缀，直接打开帖子），并把该方式与'有 targeted problem'绑定。

G007.target_statement: Solve a problem that was defined before logging in, so that the session ends with the problem solved.
G007.label: direct
G007.rationale: T009 说明登录前已定义问题时，该次使用的结果是问题被解决；同一段也说明无预设目标时没有特定结果，因此目标限定于预先定义的问题。

G008.target_statement: Reach authentic answers quickly on Reddit for specific queries, without spending a lot of time searching.
G008.label: direct
G008.rationale: T015 明确说在具体查询上节省时间、更快得到真实答案；T051 说搜索结果准确使其不用长时间查找。两者都指向减少查找耗时，合并为同一速度目标。
supported_parts: T015 支持'更快得到真实答案'
T051 支持'不必花大量时间查找'

G009.target_statement: Ask for advice in the relevant communities when a question is better answered by others.
G009.label: direct
G009.rationale: 受访者说明在 CS career questions、grad admissions 等社区提过很多问题，并明确'ask for advice'是有帮助的做法。

G010.target_statement: Stay updated on trends through Reddit, mainly for events tied to followed subreddits or major worldwide events on the popular page.
G010.label: direct
G010.rationale: T031 明确说会用 Reddit 跟进趋势，同时限定 Reddit 不是主要新闻来源，只有与关注 subreddit 相关或奥运会/诺奖级事件才会出现。

G011.target_statement: Keep news out of Reddit, using it to satisfy curiosity rather than as a news source.
G011.label: direct
G011.rationale: 原句是明确的取舍：把新闻排除在 Reddit 使用之外，因为 Reddit 用于满足好奇心而非获取新闻；T031 另说关注 India news 但几乎不互动，支持这一边界。

G012.target_statement: Research products on Reddit before buying to get balanced perspectives from people of varied backgrounds, and use those reviews in purchase decisions.
G012.label: direct
G012.rationale: T033 说明购机前在 Reddit 做了大量调研，看重其相对电商评论更平衡、来自不同背景人群的视角，并因此做出多次购买决定。

G013.target_statement: Get general health information from a community answered by healthcare professionals, such as beginner yoga routines.
G013.label: direct
G013.rationale: T035 说明 AskDoctors 由医疗专业人士回答，并举例会搜索初学者瑜伽等一般健康问题；使用过数次。

G014.target_statement: Avoid using or recommending Reddit for specific health problems, because specifics there are not trustworthy.
G014.label: direct
G014.rationale: 原句同时给出自身避免与他人不建议两个面向，理由是同段'不会信任 Reddit 上的具体健康内容'；保留为带范围的避免型目标。

G015.target_statement: Choose the feed view by mode of use: card view for passive scrolling and compact view to compare all relevant search results before opening one.
G015.label: direct
G015.rationale: T043 按使用方式给出两种视图偏好：被动浏览用卡片视图，主动搜索用紧凑视图以便先看全部相关结果再点开；同一对象的选择规则，保留两个情境。

G016.label: direct
G016.rationale: 原句是偏好而非强制要求：'有广告拦截时没有 premium 也可以'（T047）已写入 G017 的条件，本目标只保留无广告体验这一偏好方向。

G017.target_statement: Buy the premium tier when an ad blocker is unavailable, to remove ads.
G017.label: direct
G017.rationale: T047 明确表示在无法使用广告拦截的场景会购买 premium，并说明唯一好处是无广告；条件与理由均保留。

G018.target_statement: Find the exact subreddit for a topic or question instead of searching through many overlapping subreddits.
G018.label: direct
G018.rationale: T051 把'找 subreddit 很复杂'作为hindering 项，原因是任何人都能建版且不查重；T059 说找到那个 subreddit 会很有用，构成明确的期望结果。

G019.target_statement: Add a Gen-AI tool that turns a described topic into the exact subreddit to use.
G019.label: direct
G019.rationale: T059 明确提出会实现一个 Gen-AI 工具来找具体 subreddit；T051 描述其期望行为（输入主题、给出确切 subreddit）。

G020.target_statement: Post questions in the most specific relevant subreddit so that responders who know the subject matter give better answers.
G020.label: direct
G020.rationale: T059 说明发在具体 subreddit 比泛版更有价值；T061 补充预期结果是回答者更懂主题、答案更好，故把预期结果并入同一目标。

G021.target_statement: Save an unfinished post as a draft on mobile after an interruption, as is possible on desktop.
G021.label: direct
G021.rationale: T027 把移动端无法保存草稿列为具体 frustration，并指出桌面端可以做到，期望的补足能力明确。

G022.target_statement: Track comment threads clearly on mobile, comparable to the desktop view.
G022.label: direct
G022.rationale: 原句说明移动端无法直观跟踪评论串，并认为桌面端呈现更清晰，期望状态明确。

G023.target_statement: Improve the mobile app UI so that the first-party app is better than third-party wrapper apps.
G023.label: direct
G023.rationale: T063 明确要求移动端 UI 应该更好，并给出理由（基于 API 的第三方 wrapper 反而市场份额更高）；T027 的缓慢、笨重、不直观是同一改进对象。

G024.target_statement: Get reliable information by relying on communities with strong moderation, including automated checks and human moderators, while accepting that nothing online is fully reliable.
G024.label: direct
G024.rationale: 问题是'如何找到可靠信息'，回答以强审核社区（自动版主加人工版主）为判断方式，并带'没有 100% 可靠'的限定；目标与其方式、限定一致。
